identity.normalization: Packet list already ID-2 normalized (Aqua/Water/Eau one entry); normalized one-based positions; 42 entries.

cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) with a prominent reinforcing strong anionic Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (C3b: laureth-8 sulfates are strong anionic, ether type); buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5. C3b limit applies: read as a buffer the laureth-8 sulfate would make the chassis moderate, so confidence at most moderate and neighbor moderate. Further ether sulfates (Magnesium Laureth Sulfate @12, Magnesium Laureth-8 Sulfate @13, Sodium Oleth Sulfate @14, Magnesium Oleth Sulfate @17) are after the E3 point and recorded only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture; the only substantive conditioner is Polyquaternium-10 @18, after the E3 point; pearlizer PEG-3 Distearate @3 and minor humectant-type entries (Glucose @28, Inositol @37, Calcium Pantothenate @38) add little slip. No silicone, no payload lipid. Counter-signal: a cationic polymer is present; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: low: a single late cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-10 @18, after the fragrance) is the only deposition family and faces a strong reset (reinforced ether-sulfate chassis); no silicone, no lipid, no protein, no film former. W2 does not apply (one family).

excluded: Hamamelis Virginiana Water @23 and botanical extracts @30-35 (no deposition role)

weightPotential.depositionLoadRationale: One cationic polymer after the fragrance.
weightPotential.persistenceRationale: No persistent silicone or lipid system.
weightPotential.resetCapacityRationale: SLES reinforced by laureth-8 sulfate (C1 strong), with further late ether sulfates.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition absent apart from one late polymer; strong reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate needs at least one plausibly persistent system; a single post-fragrance polymer facing a strong reset is not one (no polymer floor).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: None material; complete formula, converging subjudgments.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional, claim-dependent: claims hidden. Formula carries Piroctone Olamine @8 (recognized dandruff active) and Caffeine @19 (hair-loss positioning is never a focus route, F5); a strong chassis could also suit clarifying if oily positioning appears, but conditioning low and weight low leave F6 compatibility open.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: No claims visible in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional default regular. dandruffSupport supported -> a qualifying dandruff claim would fire treatment (U3); cleansing strong -> reset intent (U4) would fire alternating; frequency wording cannot fire frequent on a strong formula.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: not_targeted whatever the positioning: CSA fails, no listed comfort or humectant/refatting route is prominent (Allantoin @16 and Niacinamide @26 are after the E3 point @11; no Glycerin/Panthenol). Counter-signal: strong cleansing. A sensitive or dry claim would therefore fail its gate (S-FAIL), decided after unblinding.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine @8 (Section 11).
